changelog.summary: Separates a helpdesk return request from a Shopify Return and validates the affected line's fulfillment route.
Adds a chat-led Shopify order and return exception proposal with two Crews and a validated merchant review.

title: Order Exception to Resolution
description: Connect an order or fulfillment problem to a return or refund request, then prepare an approved action and verify the resulting store and customer state.
setup_prompt: Use Order Exception to Resolution as a proposal for an authorized Shopify store and a return or refund request tied to an order exception. Inspect the merchant's existing Crews, Shopify orders and transactions, fulfillment, returns, helpdesk, policy, owner, and approved action routes. Propose reuse or creation of Store Operations Coordinator and Returns & Refunds Coordinator, a validated order-to-policy handoff, an unsent customer draft, an owner review, a manual first run, and proof needed after any approved refund or message. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selecting this Playbook alone does not create Crews, connect a store, refund a payment, create a label, message a customer, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized store, order ID, affected line items, and exception window
Customer return or refund request and applicable policy version
Order, payment, fulfillment, return, and prior-contact records or exports
Operations and refund approval owners with contact policy
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated event and notification route

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing Shopify Crew with a stable idempotency key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded order artifact to the authorized policy Crew

recommended_tools.name: Shopify Admin or bounded export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact store, order, line-item, payment, and refund states

recommended_tools.name: Fulfillment or shipping provider
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify shipment, delivery, and split-fulfillment status

recommended_tools.name: Helpdesk or bounded case export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read request, prior contact, owner, and provider-confirmed reply state

pulse_focus.label: Order exception resolution
focus_areas: Whether eligible order and return cases reach an owner decision within policy time
Whether refunds and customer replies are verified from provider records
review_when: A case approaches its deadline, policy or payment state changes, or an approved action lacks a receipt

outputs: Reviewed Shopify Crew roster and source map
Return or refund decision brief and unsent customer draft
Owner-approved action and provider receipt when executed
